frame.description: Increased damage versus powerful combatants. Very low heat generated. [Reload]  to vent heat from the weapon. Overheating forces a sustained vent. Manually venting at very high heat greatly increases venting speed.

perks.name: Jolting Feedback
perks.description:
Dealing repeated damage with this weapon inflicts Jolt. 

While amplified, Jolt is applied faster.

enhanced.name: Delicate Tuning
enhanced.description: While at low heat, this weapon has slightly more improved range, handling, and accuracy.

perks.name: Cooling Baubles
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup, collecting an Orb of Power, or destroying a Tangle reduces heat.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

enhanced.name: Cooling Baubles
enhanced.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup, collecting an Orb of Power, or destroying a Tangle reduces slightly more heat.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Trickle Charge
perks.description: Receiving or discharging Bolt Charge partially loads the magazine from reserves.

enhanced.name: Trickle Charge
enhanced.description: Receiving or discharging Bolt Charge partially loads an improved quantity of the magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.description: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

enhanced.name: Rapid Hit
enhanced.description: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed substantially.

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.description: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

enhanced.name: Shoot to Loot
enhanced.description: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves. Increases range.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.description: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

enhanced.name: Keep Away

perks.description:

enhanced.name: Rolling Storm
enhanced.description:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.

enhanced.name: Frenzy
